cases.name: Terri Gee
cases.about:
Terri Gee's sons, Kevin and Steve, describe their mother as an angel and their rock. They said she loved the outdoors and her family. "She was always there for us. She'd help anybody she could. She was the rock that held us all together," Kevin said. As a final act of kindness, Gee's sons said, their mother's organs were donated, saving the lives of seven other people. "My mom was a great person, willing to help anyone," Steve said.

https://www.wgal.com/article/sons-of-ephrata-woman-who-was-stabbed-strangled-to-death-at-campground-react-to-arrest-of-suspect/28187125#

cases.name: Naraly “Nara” Dianara Archibald
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Nara was a 2020 graduate of Ephrata High School and recently enrolled at HACC with the goal of becoming a doctor. Caring and selfless, Nara was a caretaker for her grandfather who has dementia. She always put others before herself and showed her love for others by lending a helping hand.

It was easy to love Nara. She had a bright and beautiful smile, kind eyes, and an empathetic heart. Smart and fun, she brought joy to so many people. Being sarcastic and goofy was her favorite vibe. Nara also had an open mind and adventurous spirit. She loved trying new things and did well when she put her mind to it. She was a talented artist, swimmer, dancer, and bow hunter. Nara also travelled the world with her family and experienced different cultures and ways of life. She had a great appreciation for nature and love for all animals."

https://www.snyderfuneralhome.com/obituary/naraly-dianara-nara-archibald/

Archibald was remembered Tuesday as a “nice, sweet girl” who regularly served as her grandmother’s caregiver. She had graduated from Ephrata High School in June and frequently shared her digital artwork on her social media accounts.

https://lancasteronline.com/news/local/man-and-woman-killed-in-shooting-at-ephrata-home-monday-died-in-murder-suicide-coroner/article_06252e0e-587f-11ec-acd5-776862566716.html?itm_source=parsely-api&utm_source=article&utm_medium=summary&utm_campaign=What%20to%20Read%20Next

Her Go Fund Me said, "She always enjoyed helping others and taking care of animals. She was a caretaker, she help to distribute food at the food bank, she collected money for wigs for cancer patients and had volunteered at the Humane League."
